title: INTERLOCKING COMPETITION: HYMNOI WISDOM OPEN
lines: 01 NEW EVENT: INTERLOCKING COMPETITION HYMNOI WISDOM OPEN
EVENT DURATION: December 29, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 08, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: Hymnoi Wisdom stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain competition rewards by clearing event stages, garrisoning posts, and completing event missions.
COLLECT COMPETITION MEDALS TO OBTAIN EVENT REWARDS
DURATION: December 29, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 08, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
MAIN REWARDS:
EPOQUE Collection - Wake Up From a Nap - Podenco,
Headhunting Permit, Battle Record, LMD, Furniture Parts, Elite Materials, etc.
NOTE:
After the event, excess competition medals will be converted into LMD, and the exchange ratio will be 1:100.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – FROM THE SPARK
DURATION: December 29, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, "From the Spark", opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Pallas
★★★★★: Projekt Red / Specter
NOTE:
From the Spark is a Standard Headhunting.
Operator Pallas will be available in Standard Headhunting in future update.
Pallas will gain more trust during the event.
03 EPOQUE COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 29, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store, including:
EPOQUE Collection - Weißer Sand – Beeswax
EPOQUE Collection - Londinium Style Miko – Tsukinogi
EPOQUE Collection - Leisurely Afternoon – Perfumer
04 CORAL COAST COLLECTION RE-EDITION AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 29, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7) – January 12, 2022, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following Outfits will be available at the Store again, including:
Coral Coast Collection - Shimmering Dew SD01 - Nearl
Coral Coast Collection - Summer Flowers FA008 - Rope
05 NEW LUCKY DROP THEMED FURNITURE SET – THE PHOTOGRAPHY HOBBYIST’S STUDIO
UPDATE TIME: December 29, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7)
DROP FURNITURE: The Photography Hobbyist's Studio
HOW TO COLLECT: Lucky drop on every stage of Main Story (excluding Challenge Mode and Tutorials) and every stage in Supplies.
DETAILS:
New furniture set The Photography Hobbyist's Studio will replace the current furniture set White Wilderness in lucky drop.
NOTE: White Wilderness will be available at the Store after December 29, 2021, 10:00 (UTC-7).
